brief: Complete the remaining DeutschMeister audit remediation, verify it in real browsers, and deploy production safely; preserve explicit gates for evidence that only the operator can provide.

goals.title: Baseline and evidence gates
goals.objective: Inventory current implementation and encode exact operator-only blockers without inventing legal or customer evidence.
goals.evidence: Created docs/release-evidence-gates.md from repository evidence. It records four non-fabrication gates with owners and acceptance criteria: operator identity, privacy/vendor facts, authentic customer proof, and authenticated GSC/DataForSEO data. Worktree commit: document release evidence gates.

goals.title: Legal and privacy hardening
goals.objective: Improve Impressum and privacy transparency using verified facts, centralize completion requirements, and add release safeguards.
goals.evidence: Centralized legal facts and conditional noindex in astro-site/src/data/legal.js; expanded Impressum and privacy draft coverage; added npm run check:legal-release, which correctly blocks on 15 verified operator/legal/vendor fields; implemented GA4 and PostHog same-session withdrawal; consent tests 2/2 and targeted ESLint passed; Astro built 128 pages; real browser render confirmed both legal pages and accept-then-withdraw reopened the consent dialog.

goals.title: English-first public experience
goals.objective: Resolve mixed-language discovery paths and make the public acquisition experience consistently understandable to English-speaking learners.
goals.evidence: English FAQ/About and grammar hubs implemented; German exam route templates share an explicit language notice; navigation identifies German destinations. Astro built 128 pages, SPA prerender built 8 routes, rendered browser checks showed FAQ interaction, English About/grammar, and German guide notice.

goals.title: Navigation pricing and trust conversion
goals.objective: Group desktop navigation, clarify no-account versus free-trial versus Pro states, and create an honest social-proof capture path.
goals.evidence: Desktop navigation is grouped in native accessible disclosures in both renderers. Pricing and signup explicitly separate anonymous A1.1 access, the account-based 7-day trial, and Pro. A Netlify learner-story form captures verified feedback only with required publication consent and a no-auto-publish promise.

goals.title: Grammar page learning and conversion UX
goals.objective: Add concise summaries, usable tables of contents, early practice calls to action, and Sentence X-Ray integration to long grammar pages.
goals.evidence: The shared topic template now gives all 84 grammar lessons a data-derived at-a-glance summary, conditional anchored contents list, early practice jump, and prefilled Sentence X-Ray links for every example.

goals.title: Accessibility and security
goals.objective: Fix remaining WCAG issues, validate keyboard zoom and automated accessibility, and move CSP from observation toward safe enforcement.
goals.evidence: Both renderers build; focused checks 5/5 pass; Lighthouse accessibility improved from 96/95 to 100/100; real-browser keyboard disclosure and 200%-equivalent reflow verified without overflow.

goals.title: Technical SEO and performance
goals.objective: Fix title warnings, validate crawl metadata and canonical coverage, run Lighthouse/CWV-style measurements, and remediate material performance defects.
goals.evidence: Shared build merge includes all Astro routes; 138 built pages pass with 0 failures/warnings; home Lighthouse 93-95 with LCP 1.5-1.6s and lesson Lighthouse 98 with LCP 1.7s; merged SEO/a11y/best-practices 100; deferred content verified in real browser.

goals.title: Production release verification
goals.objective: Run the complete automated and rendered verification suite, deploy the verified changes, and smoke-test production with an evidence-backed blocker handoff.
goals.evidence: Production commit f2c9808 pushed to audit branch and main; Netlify deploy 6aa82657f6bf78000880f945 reached ready for the exact commit; smoke tests passed for homepage, grammar, pricing, signup, privacy, Impressum, learner-story route, canonical redirects, CSP headers, and real HTTP 404; production browser rendered the deferred German Nouns & Gender rule card with no production console errors.
